notes.title: 🐍 The Coma 2B supports Sensa HD Haptics & Chroma peripherals with update 1.2.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/fdb1b2ab6a16924279bf04a22f05c3dd7eaca692.jpg[/img]

Greetings all!

If you've been following [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] for a while (since around mid-September or earlier), you may have noticed that we announced at the time that the game would be one of the early bird titles to support Razer's Sensa HD Haptics peripherals. You know, that gaming cushion that attaches to your chair and can literally kick your butt.

And yes, we kept our word: [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] supports Sensa HD Haptics peripherals and the Chroma RGB ecosystem from TODAY with the update v1.2.0!

But let's start from the beginning, with two questions: '[i]Why are you doing this?[/i]' and '[i]How should a cushion for my chair improve my gaming experience?[/i]'. Let's answer the first question first: The reason is me, Tim. Hi! Well, personally I am very open-minded about such technical gadgets. And I am convinced that an intensive gaming experience can benefit from being more than just an audiovisual experience. I am a big fan of strengthening the immersion of video games to delve even deeper and making it possible to experience them with as many senses as possible.

That's exactly why I'm the one here at Headup who initiates such implementations. And so I asked myself which of our games could benefit from also being a 'tangible' experience (which is also the answer to the second question).

And scary games - such as [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] - are a good choice. Players once again stumble into the dark mirror dimension and have to survive and stop the evil. As is typical of the series, you flee, hide, and survive from entities that pose a constant threat. And all these actions in The Coma 2B: Catacomb are accompanied and reinforced by haptic feedback.

The gaming cushion ([url=https://www.razer.com/gaming-chairs-accessories/razer-freyja]Razer Freyja[/url]) has six haptic zones: two in the shoulder blade area, two in the lower back area; one each on the left and on the right. Plus one zone under each bun. The haptic feedback can be controlled in terms of intensity and you will definitely feel it when danger threatens or Youngho takes damage! But not only physical damage or stress is 'noticeable', but also many other effects that make sense, such as explosions or situations in general in which the camera shakes (according to the shake intensity with 'Low', 'Medium' and 'Strong' haptic feedback).

As I said, I am a friend of gimmicks that increase immersion. That's why I also love it when the gameplay is extended beyond the limits of the screen through RGB illumination. And that is the reason why the haptic effects are additionally supported by RGB effects in Razer's Chroma ecosystem: if Youngho takes damage, stressed or got caught, this is also visible on the periphery in the form of RGB effects. We have also implemented some QoL improvements through Chroma; the hotkeys for the controls are specially illuminated and Youngho's life indicator is also displayed via the F-keys.

Well, in the end I can only speak for us (Headup and Dvora Studio) and myself personally, and we are really happy with the results of both Sensa HD Haptics and Chroma and how it supports and accompanies the dark and scary [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] experience and immersion.

Personally, I love it. ❤️ If I didn't already have it, the cushion would definitely be on top of my Christmas wish list.

Pre-seasonal greetings!
Tim

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has been playing the game with interest and love. While we know that many of you loved the game, we think it's important to hear from those who didn't - it's what makes the game's bones and muscles.

We've reviewed all of the cold feedback we've received from many of you, and we've picked out the things we can fix.

[list]
[*] We noticed that the flower shop visit in the achievement only clears 1 of the 3 routes, so we've fixed that.
[*] The final stage has been significantly improved: we've added a lot more hiding spots and removed traps that we deemed unnecessary, and we've adjusted the path of the killer Hyungbae to make sure it doesn't put unfair stress on you (even though it's still a difficult final stage).
[*] In some events with Killer appearances, players were having to stop while the Killer approached, and we've listened to your feedback and fixed this (The Butcher in the Market, Killer Song in the Police Station, and Killer Hyungbae in the Gym).
[*] Killer Hyungbae's dash speed was too difficult, so we've reduced it by two-thirds. (We've been playing against this killer for a long time, so we didn't realize how difficult it was.)
[*] In some scenes where the Killer appears, the Killer is too close to the player to deal with, so we've increased the distance a bit. (Killer Song in the school, spider monster in the cave, etc.)
[/list]

We've taken your feedback into consideration, and we hope this patch makes your gaming experience a little better. Thank you.

notes.title: 🔪 Update 1.0.8 released for The Coma 2B: Catacomb; adds Hardcore Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/d51ea8caffd388e98469707f1452dbff886d7a7b.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Ghost Vigilantes!
 
Thank you for waiting for this further update! I think this is almost the final hotfix for [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] and I planned for this to be the main update to the game's difficulty balance that fans have been looking for. It adds new save points, makes some additional fixes, and adds the brand new Hardcore Mode (you can find more information below).

These are the full patch notes:

[h3][b]UPDATE 1.0.8:[/b][/h3]

[b]New Save Points:[/b]
As many people requested, this update reduces your gameplay stress while keeping the tension.

[list][*] [b][u]School[/u][/b]
There will be small icons next to the classroom passwords, to prevent spending too much time on them. However, 3A classroom will have both, the hiding place and a save point, so the sight will be very precious.
Counselling Office also has a save point now. If you are exploring the main building thoroughly, each floor will have its own save point.[/list][list][*] [b][u]Police[/u][/b]
The cop provides a new save point, so you won't need to visit the parking lot nor 2F storage while doing in the right side.
The police chief office will also have a new save point.[/list][list][*] [b][u]Hospital[/u][/b]
SH secret monitor room has a new save point.[/list][list][*] [b][u]The Cave[/u][/b]
The equipment storage of B3F has a new save point.[/list]
 
[b]Additional Fixes:[/b]
[list][*] The spider monster event in the webby cave is much more dynamic now; the escaping route got changed and altered. You are also now able to use the Chinese knife.
[*] Black screen fixed on the 2nd entrance of the cave
[*] Fixed an issue with the game getting stuck after meeting Yaesol
[*] Fixed the achievement "Enter the Forbidden Zone"
[*] Fixed the blinded overlay being displayed in main menu
[*] Fixed startup black screens. If you still have your old savegame where this error occured - this should now be working again![/list]

[h3][b]THE COMA 2B: HARDCORE MODE[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/403de985d25f5bd228698100f327a823f5baccf5.jpg[/img]

And for everyone who is looking for some extra challenge we are happy to present: [u][b]The Coma 2B: Hardcore Mode[/b][/u]! It is a free and extra hard time-based game mode taking place in the Sewa High. You only have 10 minutes to find Seho and get the pendant - are you tough enough to beat it?

You can play the Hardcore Mode by right-clicking on the game in your Steam library, hitting [b]"Properties", "Betas" and selecting "harcore_mode"[/b]. No worries, this version has its own savegame and you can get back to the full game anytime by opting-out of the beta branch again!

Until then, we hope you have a tense time in the mirror dimension!
Minho, Dvora Studio, Headup & Nordic Stone Studio

notes.title: 🔪 Update 1.0.5 and 1.0.6 released for The Coma 2B: Catacomb!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/8564ee3a8d6ee55210e0d518c7b8ae0b7e12efd2.jpg[/img]

Dear Ghost Vigilantes!
 
Thank you so much for playing [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] and providing us with tons of valuable feedback. This really helps us a lot and we are able to respond even faster with updates to give you the best possible The Coma experience!
 
We have recently released [b]update 1.0.5 and 1.0.6[/b] - here are the full patch notes:


[h3][b]UPDATE 1.0.6:[/b][/h3]
[list] [*] Fixed the reported gamepad issues, see below for details (D-pad for gamepads in QTE is fixed; D-pad usage in phone UI (Shadow Telecom) is fixed)
[*] The issue where your DLCs disappear in the DLC menu is solved! (Finally)
[*] Killer Hyungbae was unbalanced/overpowered. We re-balanced him and set his power a bit lower
[*] Main menu’s layout is fixed for various monitor sizes
[*] Necroblade patch: The delay time to activate it is reduced by half. Use it faster! When you expel the roamers, they will take much more time to respawn[/list]
[h3][b]UPDATE 1.0.5:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Final Stage Difficulty Fixes:[/b] We've fixed the map structure to make it clearer, as unreasonably connected passages were causing confusion. We've also lowered the difficulty across the board. (If you beat the game in version 1.0.5, you did so on the hardest difficulty and we thank you for completing the most dangerous challenge)
[*] [b]Patch for game freezes, crashes and BGM mutes:[/b] The cause is still unclear, but there have been issues with the BGM disappearing at unspecified points, game events not working, etc. We believe it's primarily a RAM usage issue, so we've optimized it to reduce the overload from scene loads
[*] Fixed the arrival point from the hospital to the market
[*] Fixed the V-Sister remaining in the school
[*] Fixed some weird locations in the map UI[/list]
[h3][b]Language updates:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Thai:[/b] Updated to fix some oddities (hints and lore)
[*] [b]Turkish:[/b] The font itself has been replaced and many other areas have been checked and updated
[*] [b]Russian, German, French:[/b] Fixed a bug with Color Tag
[*] [b]Korean:[/b] Fixed typos and incorrect wording
[*] [b]Ukrainian:[/b] Updated the text with additional checks and improvements
[*] [b]Chinese:[/b] Updated to include the latest review version[/list]


Please continue to provide us with further feedback! As I have mentioned, this is very helpful for us, so that we can continue to provide you with updates.
 
Until then, we wish you a good time in the mirror dimension!
Minho, Dvora Studio, Headup & Nordic Stone Studio

notes.title: ✅ Everything you need to know before enrolling in Sehwa High!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/8e45f693a41f3f44a7d4bcd59fd330d814cd28b0.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dear Ghost Vigilantes!

We're gearing up for the release of [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] on Friday, and we couldn't be happier with all of the feedback, comments and nice words we’ve received about the demo so far. With all of your support, we were able to ensure [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] is the best it can possibly be, and we're incredibly proud of the hard work we put into the third installment in the Coma series.

We wanted to take the time to look at what the syllabus, the extracurricular activities, lunch menus and, of course, your lovely teachers and the other students have in store for you in Sehwa High from [u][b]October 25[/b][/u]! So, here you go:

[list][*] It's a Korean survival horror adventure game set between [b]The Coma: Cutting Class/Recut[/b] and [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b]
[*] Run and hide in terrifying pursuits from various old and new killers, and an even more vicious enemy AI than before. Run, hide, survive
[*] Explore locations seen in both previous The Coma games, as well as new locales
[*] Trade and gather resources in the markets and collect resources to survive
[*] Vibrant, hand-illustrated visuals and comic strip-like animated sequences
[*] Learn real-world Korean historical lore alongside the fictional story
[*] 6+ hours of tense gameplay, with a deep story fleshing out the world of The Coma
[*] Full mouse + keyboard support, alongside all common controller setups
[*] Steam Deck verified! ✅[/list]

Make sure you pack your school bags, sharpen your pencils and pay extra good attention in class – It’s time to survive The Coma once again!

It's only two more days to go. See you soon in The Coma 2B, friends!

Much love,
Minho & Dvora Studio

notes.title: 🔪 Play The Coma 2B: Catacomb Demo at gamescom, or simply at home!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/5f557042a092a2801707c1fc2f7d79e0816a044d.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Ghost Vigilantes!

Like each and every August, gamescom calls, and we answer: for the very first time you have the chance to get your hands on a demo of [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b]!

Get into the shoes of Youngho Choi (again), and venture into the terrifying mirror dimension of the Coma (yet again). The demo includes the first two chapters of the game, and lets you breathe the air of the first hour of [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b].

So, if you're planing to attend gamescom in Cologne from August 21-25, stop by the Headup booth and say "hi"! We are part of the Indie Arena Booth, and can be found here: [u][b]Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019[/b][/u]:
